description: This Dart file implements a Flutter screen called 'HabitsScreen' that manages a list of habits. It supports loading habits from a service, displaying them in a list, adding new habits via a dialog, and deleting habits with swipe actions.

classes.name: HabitsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the habits management screen.

classes.name: HabitsScreenState
classes.description: State class handling the logic for loading, adding, and deleting habits, as well as managing UI state.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads habits from the HabitService and updates state, handling loading indicator and errors.

methods.name: _addHabitDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to input a new habit's name and frequency, then calls the service to add it.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Deletes a given habit via the service and updates the local list.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Overrides the StatefulWidget lifecycle method to load habits when the widget is initialized.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the habits list, including loading indicator, error messages, habit list with dismissible delete, and spacing.

methods.name: showAddDialog
methods.description: Public method to trigger the add habit dialog.
